title: Define Charts rules

canonicalSources: qualified public playback/listener events when a later runtime source is implemented
eligible PUBLIC 420Hz community source records under HZ-GCA-1.10

chartFamilies.purpose: rank eligible published recordings by qualified engagement under exact chart policy
rank recent qualified engagement velocity under bounded window/decay policy
deterministic recency view over newly eligible published recordings; not popularity authority
aggregate eligible recording/community signals to artist reference under exact policy
rank only explicitly eligible PUBLIC favorite/community signals under the frozen methodology

signalVocabulary.meaning: observed playback-start/attempt or equivalent raw event; never automatically chart credit
playback event satisfying the exact chart policy's duration/completion, dedupe, source-readiness and anti-abuse gates
privacy-preserving distinct audience contribution within policy window; identity mechanism must not broaden Identity authority
eligible PUBLIC RecordingFavorite contribution; private favorite excluded
eligible add to PUBLIC playlist subject to dedupe/anti-gaming policy
eligible PUBLIC ArtistFollow contribution only for artist/community charts where policy allows
share/reference signal may be displayed analytically but is excluded from chart score by default v1
Award vote is a separate product-domain object and never chart credit
Search interaction is non-authoritative presentation telemetry and excluded from v1 score
generation/project activity is private/product workflow state and excluded from Charts

eligibilityRules: target Recording/Creator must be eligible PUBLIC presentation under canonical Creative/publication/source rules
PRIVATE and UNLISTED source content is excluded from chart eligibility
deleted, withdrawn, unavailable, rights-blocked or stale-unverified source objects are excluded or marked ineligible before snapshot publication
Chart methodology may filter by disclosure class, genre, mood, category or release period only when the source field is public and policy-defined
AI disclosure class is a filter/facet, not a positive or negative weighting by itself unless a later policy version explicitly says so
Award state does not determine chart eligibility unless a later versioned policy explicitly adds a non-circular rule

timeWindows.alignment: UTC rolling/fixed policy version must declare exact mode

methodology.formula: score = qualifiedPlayPoints + distinctListenerBonus + publicFavoritePoints + publicPlaylistAddPoints + publicFollowArtistPoints
interpretation: v1 freezes qualified plays as the only positive score weight
other eligible signal classes are frozen for future policy use/analytics but have zero weight in v1
changing any nonzero/zero weight, qualification rule, dedupe rule, decay rule or window semantics requires a new chartPolicyVersion
no hidden personalized or sponsored boost may alter canonical chart rank

qualifiedPlayRules: a raw play becomes QUALIFIED_PLAY only after the exact runtime playback source satisfies the versioned minimum-listen/completion rule; HZ-GCA-1.11 does not invent an unavailable playback-service threshold
one event/source replay key contributes at most once
retries, duplicate delivery and projection rebuild cannot multiply chart credit
self-play/creator-controlled traffic may be capped/excluded by later runtime policy but cannot be silently privileged
automated/bot/repeated abnormal traffic must be rejected or down-weighted only through documented deterministic policy, never ad hoc manual score edits
qualified play evidence must retain source/reference/checkpoint sufficient for deterministic rebuild without storing protected raw identity payloads
playback visibility/access must have been valid at event time and target must remain eligible at snapshot publication
distinctListenerRules: distinct-listener contribution must use privacy-preserving bounded identifiers or aggregation and must not require publishing Wallet/Identity linkage
one listener contributes at most once per target per declared distinct-listener window
sybil resistance may use qualified rate/behavior/account/device signals only under later privacy/threat-model policy; no legal-identity requirement is implied
distinct-listener data is derived analytics and never Identity credential/trust authority
antiGamingRules: dedupe by stable event/replay key before scoring
cap repeated contribution from one bounded listener/source according to the versioned policy
reject impossible timestamps, future-window events, malformed source references and source-window mismatches
exclude known test/synthetic fixtures from production charts
exclude private/unlisted events from public charts
provider/operator/admin cannot directly edit final rank or score without publishing a new policy/input correction record and deterministic rebuild
sponsored placement must never be mixed into chart rank; sponsored discovery remains separately labeled Search presentation
community relation replay cannot inflate counts or chart score
award votes cannot be reused as chart events
chart manipulation enforcement/remediation may flag/exclude inputs but cannot rewrite Creative rights, payments or Awards history
snapshotRules: ChartSnapshot is immutable derived output keyed by chartPolicyVersion, windowStart, windowEnd, sourceCheckpoint and resultCommitment
ranking is deterministic for the same policy version and exact eligible input set
ties are broken deterministically by score descending, then stable canonical target identifier ascending unless a later policy version explicitly changes tie-break semantics
snapshot generation records source checkpoints/freshness needed to reproduce the result
a corrected/rebuilt snapshot creates a new snapshot/result commitment and supersession reference rather than mutating historical snapshot bytes in place
ChartSnapshot never becomes source authority for play events, community relations, rights or Award votes
freshnessRebuildRules: Indexer/Search/Analytics inputs are non-authoritative and charts fail closed or label stale/degraded when required source freshness/provenance is unavailable
non-finalized/reorg-sensitive source inputs must follow the owning Indexer/source canonicality model
projection rebuild from the same checkpoint/policy must reproduce the same ordered result
deleted/tombstoned/ineligible source state must not resurrect through stale caches or rebuild
current charts may supersede prior snapshots while historical snapshot commitments remain immutable presentation history
Search may index published ChartSnapshots as public derived results but cannot rewrite rank
privacyRules: PRIVATE favorites and PRIVATE playlists are excluded from public chart inputs
UNLISTED playlists/content are excluded from public chart inputs
raw listener identity, wallet secrets, private playback payloads and private project data are not chart outputs
public snapshot output contains target refs, rank/score, policy version, window, checkpoint and result commitment only as policy allows
privacy-safe aggregation must prevent chart publication from exposing a hidden private relation
chartAwardsCommunitySeparation: follow/favorite/playlist/community actions do not automatically become chart points; only policy-approved signal classes with explicit nonzero weight do
AwardVote is never a chart signal
chart rank/score does not create Award eligibility, nomination, ballot placement or winner status
community popularity and chart performance are distinct from Creative ownership/rights and payment entitlement
future Awards policy may reference chart snapshots only through an explicit versioned eligibility rule that avoids circular mutation of the chart itself
displayRules: UI must show chart family, policy version, time window and freshness/staleness context
rank is presentation/derived truth, not canonical ownership/trust/quality judgment
raw plays, qualified plays, distinct listeners, favorites and Award votes must not be conflated in labels
if methodology changes, current and historical snapshots must identify the applicable chartPolicyVersion
paid/sponsored placement cannot be visually merged with organic ChartSnapshot ranking
failureRules: PRIVATE or UNLISTED activity entering a public chart fails closed
AwardVote used as chart credit fails closed
duplicate/replayed event producing additional chart credit fails closed
snapshot without policy version/window/source checkpoint/result commitment is invalid
non-deterministic tie-breaking for identical input set is invalid
stale/degraded source presented as current without disclosure is invalid
manual/operator rank mutation without policy/input correction and rebuild is invalid
sponsored placement altering chart rank is invalid
chart score granting rights, payment, Award result, Identity trust or governance authority is invalid
invariants: HZGCA-CHART-001 Charts are versioned rebuildable derived projections and never canonical protocol authority
HZGCA-CHART-002 RAW_PLAY and QUALIFIED_PLAY are distinct; only policy-qualified play may score
HZGCA-CHART-003 one replay/event key contributes at most once to the applicable chart policy/window
HZGCA-CHART-004 PRIVATE and UNLISTED activity never enters public chart scoring
HZGCA-CHART-005 AwardVote is categorically separate and never chart credit
HZGCA-CHART-006 v1 positive score weight is qualified plays only; other frozen community signals have zero score weight until a new policy version
HZGCA-CHART-007 methodology/window/weight/dedupe/tie-break changes require a new chartPolicyVersion
HZGCA-CHART-008 same policy version plus same eligible input set/checkpoint yields deterministic ordered result
HZGCA-CHART-009 ties are deterministic and cannot depend on database iteration order
HZGCA-CHART-010 ChartSnapshot preserves window, policy version, source checkpoint and result commitment
HZGCA-CHART-011 rebuild/correction creates superseding snapshot rather than mutating historical snapshot in place
HZGCA-CHART-012 Search/Indexer/Analytics remain non-authoritative inputs/projections and stale/degraded state is explicit
HZGCA-CHART-013 community replay, share counts, Search clicks and generation counts cannot silently inflate chart score
HZGCA-CHART-014 sponsored placement never alters organic chart ranking
HZGCA-CHART-015 chart publication does not expose protected listener/community/private payloads
HZGCA-CHART-016 chart rank creates no Creative rights, payment/reward entitlement, Identity trust, governance authority or Award result
HZGCA-CHART-017 source deletion/withdrawal/ineligibility prevents stale projection resurrection into current chart eligibility
HZGCA-CHART-018 Charts policy creates no new playback, media, Identity, Awards, payment, Search or governance authority
exitCriteria: Chart authority is explicitly derived/rebuildable and source authority is preserved
raw play, qualified play, distinct listener, community signals and Award votes are semantically separated
initial chart families, time windows and v1 scoring methodology are explicit
qualification/dedupe/anti-gaming/privacy rules are explicit without inventing unavailable runtime thresholds
deterministic snapshot, tie-break, source checkpoint, rebuild/supersession and stale-source rules are explicit
machine verifier enforces vocabulary, v1 weights, deterministic snapshot requirements and no-escalation invariants
no ABI, live playback analytics source, deployment, provider or testnet state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.12 through HZ-GCA-1.20
